def solve(I):
    cnt=C(x for r in I for x in r)
    bg,c2=cnt.most_common(2)[0][0],cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(h) if not any(x==bg for x in I[r])]
    sc=[c for c in range(w) if not any(I[r][c]==bg for r in range(h))]
    # intersection matrix
    inter=[[I[r][c] for c in sc] for r in sr]
    out=[]
    for bi in range(len(sr)-1):
        row=[]
        for bj in range(len(sc)-1):
            corners=[inter[bi][bj], inter[bi][bj+1], inter[bi+1][bj], inter[bi+1][bj+1]]
            if len(set(corners))==1 and corners[0]!=c2:
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def load():

def f(I):
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in I for x in r); mc=cnt.most_common()
    bg=mc[0][0]; h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    # separator lines: rows/cols containing NO background cell
    sr=[r for r in range(h) if not any(x==bg for x in I[r])]
    sc=[c for c in range(w) if not any(I[r][c]==bg for r in range(h))]
    out=[]
    for bi in range(len(sr)-1):
        row=[]
        for bj in range(len(sc)-1):
            cs=[I[sr[bi+j]][sc[bj+k]] for j,k in [(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)]]
            nz=set(v for v in cs if v!=bg and v!=cs[0] and False)
            anom={v for v in cs if v!=bg and v!=max(set(cs),default=bg)}
            # proper: exclude bg; sep color is the dominant non-bg color overall
    sep=collections.Counter(x for r in I for x in r if x!=bg).most_common(1)[0][0] if False else None
    sep=max(((v,cnt[v]) for v in cnt if v!=bg), key=lambda kv:kv[1])[0]
    out=[]
    for bi in range(len(sr)-1):
        row=[]
        for bj in range(len(sc)-1):
            cs=[I[sr[bi+j]][sc[bj+k]] for j,k in [(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)]]
            nz={v for v in cs if v not in (bg,sep)}
            row.append(next(iter(nz)) if len(nz)==1 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def solve(I):
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in I for x in r); mc=cnt.most_common()
    bg=mc[0][0]; h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(h) if sum(x==bg for x in I[r])==0]
    sc=[c for c in range(w) if sum(I[r][c]==bg for r in range(h))==0]
    out=[]
    for bi in range(len(sr)-1):
        row=[]
        for bj in range(len(sc)-1):
            cs=[I[sr[bi+j]][sc[bj+k]] for j,k in [(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)]]
            nz={v for v in cs if v not in (bg,cnt.most_common(2)[1][0])}
            row.append(next(iter(nz)) if len(nz)==1 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
print(solve(I1)==O1, solve(I2)==O2)
R=solve(T)
for r in R: print(r)
print(json.dumps(R))

def solve(I):
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in I for x in r); mc=cnt.most_common()
    bg=mc[0][0]; h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    sep=mc[1][0] if len(mc)>1 else None
    # separator lines: rows/cols whose cells are NEVER background
    sr=[r for r in range(h) if not any(x==bg for x in I[r])]
    sc=[c for c in range(w) if not any(I[r][c]==bg for r in range(h))]
    out=[]
    for bi in range(len(sr)-1):
        row=[]
        for bj in range(len(sc)-1):
            cs=[I[sr[bi+j]][sc[bj+k]] for j,k in [(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)]]
            nz={v for v in cs if v not in (bg,sep)}
            row.append(next(iter(nz)) if len(nz)==1 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
print(solve(I1)==O1, solve(I2)==O2)
R=solve(T)
for r in R: print(r)
print(json.dumps(R))

import os,re,collections,json,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); I1,O1=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
I2,O2=G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output']
T=G['Test input']

def parse(I):
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in I for x in r); mc=cnt.most_common()
    bg=mc[0][0]; h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    sep=mc[1][0]
    sr=[r for r in range(h) if not any(x==bg for x in I[r])]
    sc=[c for c in range(w) if not any(I[r][c]==bg for r in range(h))]
    return bg,sep,sr,sc

for nm,I,O in [('d1',I1,O1),('d2',I2,O2)]:
